title: Sly 2: Band of Thieves arrives on PlayStation 2
summary: In 2004, Sly 2: Band of Thieves became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.

blocks.text: In 2004, Sly 2: Band of Thieves became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the platform category, Sly 2: Band of Thieves broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
